resources.string: Use this phone with your computer\'s mouse and keyboard

Lets the computer you pair with WinLink control this phone with its mouse and keyboard: move the pointer off the computer\'s screen edge and onto the phone. WinLink shows a pointer, taps and scrolls where you click, types into the text box you\'re in, and presses Back, Home and Recents. It only acts while a paired computer sends it the mouse and keyboard, over WinLink\'s encrypted connection; the only thing it reads is the text box you\'re typing in, and it sends nothing from the phone.
